label: A repository setting
think: What does the setting protect against? The issue says what went wrong without it.
Who is slowed down by it? A rule on main means every major release becomes a pull request that you merge.
Is it reversible? A ruleset can be switched off in one click; do it, and watch the first release.
Only an admin can change it.
chat: This card asks Dinis to change a GitHub repository setting. Help him weigh the protection against the friction, and find the exact setting.
